title: Uniform-family placement draw duplicated verbatim in two branches of growth_plan_demand
evidence:
core/growth.odin:573-581 (no-eligible-cluster fallback): "router_slot := growth_junction_slot_at(t, rng_range(rng, 0, i32(nj) - 1))
				dir := growth_dir_pick(rng)
				lo := GROWTH_OUT_MIN_TILES
				hi := span
				if lo > hi {
					lo = hi // degenerate span guard — the draw stays in [0, span]
				}
				dist := rng_range(rng, lo, hi)
				pos = t.node_pos[router_slot] + dir * dist" — repeated byte-identically at core/growth.odin:591-599 (the coin-fail uniform-family else branch).
detail: Two verbatim copies of the same rng draw sequence must be maintained in lockstep; editing one copy's draws shifts the E10 growth/demand rng interleaving silently. growth_dir_pick was already extracted — the remaining 8 lines deserve the same treatment.
recommended_fix: Extract a growth_uniform_candidate(t, nj, span, rng) -> [2]i32 helper (identical draw order) and call it from both branches.
